svg.title: Reefguard Barracks — Reefguard drill ring
svg.desc: Bunk pods and gear galleries wrap a dry practice court. A low wet demonstration lane has a parallel dry deck; footlockers lead to observation platforms. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Bunk pods and gear galleries wrap a dry practice court. A low wet demonstration lane has a
